title: New app-layer surfaces lack programmatic pixel verification — scratch pixel-scan exists only as a conditional manual fallback
evidence:
spec-v2-visibility.md:105: "**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- Scratch capture (rlsw shadow + LoadImageFromScreen, the 5.3 addendum recipe): drive `draw_world` + `draw_pool_gauge` + `draw_drop_markers` on a surge fixture; PIL-scan the pool-bar rect for the expected fill color + a marker's presence near a known bundle midpoint; confirm no overlap with the SLA block rect."
_pr_body.md:1: "# Story 5.2 — Node health states (per-node 🟢→🟡→🔴 surface)"
detail: Programmatic pixel-scan evidence is absent: the spec frames it as a manual if-no-CLI fallback, and the provided PR body is 5.2's, covering none of this job. The green harness run (29/29, verified) proves only T2-invisibility; the new surfaces' pixel correctness is unverified.
recommended_fix: Commit a scratch capture or harness demo asserting pool-bar fill color, SHEDDING tag, and marker anchor pixels at a known bundle, so the five surfaces carry positive pixel proof, not just T2-invisibility.

title: Why-dropped split is hidden when a class's only drops are 2.3 silent severance culls
evidence:
app/main.odin:1476: "if acc.dropped > 0 && int(c) < len(app.drop_reasons) {"
app/main.odin:1367: "if int(site.class) >= len(app.drop_reasons) {"
core/flow.odin:856: "sla_count_drop(&state.flow, p.class)" (the silent cull — no event, no Drop_Site)
detail: Reason rows are created only by drop_sites entries; the 2.3 cull increments dropped with no site. A class whose losses are all severed culls then shows "drop N" with no "(severed N)" — the cause stays unnamed despite the "every loss keeps a named cause" claim.
recommended_fix: Drop the row-existence gate: read zeros for a missing reason row (or grow the row for any class with dropped > 0) so all-severed classes still name "severed N".
